If Wishes Could Kill

기리고 (Girigo)

K-Drama · Series · South Korea · 2026

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐∞/10

Overview

If Wishes Could Kill follows five high school students — Yoo Se-ah, Lee Na-ri, Kim Geon-Woo, Kang Ha-Joon, and Choi Hyeong-wook — who become involved with Girigo, a mysterious wish-granting application. After a student uses the application and dies under mysterious circumstances, the group discovers that Girigo is connected to a series of supernatural events and predicted deaths. They begin investigating the application's origin while trying to stop the curse before more people die. With the help of Ha-Young and his Husband, the students uncover the disturbing history behind Girigo and the people responsible for its curse.

My Review

The thrill of this series was SO GOOD that I couldn't even finish watching it past midnight because I was literally getting chills. I know this isn't exactly the scariest series ever made, but the thrill it gives is INSANE. Every episode was so good, from episode 1 all the way to the last episode. I honestly think this is one of the best thrilling series I've ever watched. To be honest, I'm a coward when it comes to ghost movies and paranormal stuff. HAHAHAHA. I don't usually watch that kind of horror because I'm more comfortable with horror that isn't focused on ghosts or paranormal things. But this series somehow made me try to conquer that fear. Before, jump scares would actually make me jump and get shocked. But while watching this, I was somehow just sitting there like: "Wew." HAHAHAHAHA. I think I'm not as afraid as I used to be anymore. I really loved the five friends — Choi Hyeong-wook, Lee Na-ri, Yoo Se-ah, Kim Geon-Woo, and Kang Ha-Joon. Their friendship was one of my favorite parts of the series. I also really loved Ha-Young and his Husband. They were such a great addition to the story. And yes... Kang Ha-Joon is my type. HAHAHAHAHA. I really liked his character, especially because of his programming knowledge and how he helped investigate Girigo. I was irritated with Kim Geon-Woo during one scene because I thought he wasn't using his brain. But later, I realized that I had completely misjudged him. I ended up appreciating his character more. The plot twist wasn't something I couldn't predict, especially when it came to figuring out who was behind everything, but the way the story kept revealing information was what made it so thrilling. One of the parts that really pissed me off was the flashback showing the origin of Girigo. I fucking hated Kwon Si-won for what she did to Do Hye-ryung. Yes, what Hye-Ryung did was wrong, but I still couldn't accept what Si-won did afterward. She exposed Hye-Ryung's confession by posting and sending the video, which eventually contributed to everything that happened. And GiTae pissed me off too. I hated the way he humiliated Hye-Ryung about her confession. Yes, Si-won was the one who pushed him into doing it, but he still could have refused. Honestly, I felt like GiTae and Si Woon both deserved what happened to them. But what Si Woon did afterward was even worse because she involved innocent people who had nothing to do with what happened. That's the part that really made me angry — why punish people who weren't responsible? I also felt really sad about the five friends because only three of them remained by the end. After everything they went through together, it was painful seeing their group reduced like that. Despite all of that, I absolutely loved this series. It gave me thrill, chills, mystery, friendship, plot twists, and just enough horror to make a coward like me actually finish a paranormal series. This series genuinely made me feel like I was conquering one of my fears. What if the Girigo app really exists? HAHAHAHAHAHA. Nope. I'm not downloading that shit. Highly recommended. ∞/10.

Favorite Scene/Part

The origin of Girigo: one of my favorite parts was the flashback revealing the origin of Girigo. It was one of the moments where the story finally showed what happened in the past and why the curse existed. It also made me understand why the characters involved became so important to the whole story. At the same time, it was the scene that made me hate Si Woon the most because of what she did to Hye-Ryung.

Favorite Quote/Lines

"What if that app really exists?" Not an actual dialogue quote from the series — this is my own thought after watching it. Because after everything that happened, the idea of a real Girigo app is terrifying.
